status: bounded proposal; no implementation authorized in this stage
exactQuestion: Does an independently checked rational six-state representation of the existing fixed-parameter two-coil/mechanical model satisfy its stated positive storage, dissipative block and two-port identities, and reject specified misleading mutations?
baselineAlreadyDone: Scalar oscillator exact identity; floating-point EM phasor/storage comparisons; no exact six-state certificate bound to the full model.
distinctNewObjective: Exact nonzero-mutual-inductance and transducer block certificate with both source ports, rank/domain gates, SI normalization and explicit F=0 browser mapping.
noveltyLabel: Established passive-network identity newly implemented and checked for this project; no new mathematical or physical discovery.

fixture.coefficientUnitSystem: SI magnitudes; all decimal values stored as exact numerator/denominator strings

premises: No omitted mathematical input: two-port model includes external F; browser specialization sets F=0
RMS browser phasors; physical derivative/storage use instantaneous real variables

hypothesisLedger.analyticalDomain: General stated energy identity follows by differentiating the displayed quadratic storage and substituting the fixed-parameter equations; independent reviewer must inspect this derivation. Finite certificate executions alone do not prove the full parameter family.
hypothesisLedger.numericalContract: Three finite exact cases: base fixture, zero-loss specialization, invertible coordinate transform. A,B,C,Q assembly has no fitted parameters.
hypothesisLedger.units: q in C, x in m, i in A, v in m/s; u=(V,N), y=(A,m/s); each supply product is W. Record dimension exponents and normalize with 1 s,1 J,1 V,1 A,1 N,1 m, hence 1 W. A numeric identity without this mapping is not semantic admission.

proposedProofOrTest: Freeze source hashes, instantaneous equations, state ordering, units, fixture and two ports before code.
Author producer assembly from circuit/mechanical equations; independently author checker to consume matrices and witnesses, not reconstruct them through the producer functions.
Check Q=Q^T, Q=T^T diag(d) T, rank(T)=6 and every d>0 with exact Fraction arithmetic.
Check QA+A^TQ=-2*Lloss*Dloss*Lloss^T, Dloss diagonal nonnegative, QB=C^T and every matrix dimension.
Run fixed positive and wrong controls, recording exact mismatch coefficients or rank/domain reasons.

For F=0 only, compare independent rational-frequency complex response to emSolve using omega=(100,1000,5000) rad/s and frequencyHz=omega/(2*pi), driveVrms=1, coupling=1/4; this is separately labeled floating-point adapter checking.
Independent skeptic checks frozen negative cases, storage/port semantics and F=0 specialization; corpus records the resulting exact statement and evidence class.

Optional bounded Lean gate only after exact receipt: pin toolchain/dependencies and encode selected finite matrix/quadratic-form proposition; build and inventory axioms. No success label without actual execution.

witnessDesign.storageFactor: T is identity except T[i1,i2]=M/L1; diagonal d=(1/C1,1/C2,k,L1,L2-M^2/L1,m). Check factor orientation and exact rank.
witnessDesign.portDimensions: A,Q 6x6; B 6x2; C 2x6; T 6x6; Lloss 6x3; Dloss 3x3.

positiveControl.meaning: Nonzero M and g, all losses positive; exact full block certificate.
Set R1,R2,RL,b,bL to zero; accept semidefinite dissipation without claiming asymptotic stability. No lossless-resonance browser solve required.
z=S*znew for S=diag(2,1/3,1,5,1,1/2); transform A,B,C,Q consistently and retain exact certificate.

evidenceRequiredForAcceptance: All exact positive cases admitted; all declared wrong controls rejected for expected reasons
Every artifact has hash and source/contract binding
Independent reviewer explicitly approves mathematical state/port/unit mapping; unavailable review means not accepted
General analytic statement, finite matrix check, float browser adapter and optional Lean execution receive distinct statuses
No metric counts presented as independent physical experiments

browserAdapterAcceptance.inputMapping: F=0; coupling=M/sqrt(L1*L2)=1/4; listed rational SI parameters converted once to doubles; RMS convention
browserAdapterAcceptance.comparison: Compare complex currents/velocity and energy/power after declared SI normalization. Proposed per-field tolerance 1e-11+1e-9*abs(reference); freeze before execution. No continuum-frequency claim.

resourcesAndPrerequisites.base: At most 14 agent-hours including 3 hours independent review; CPU only, each exact run capped at 5 minutes and 1 GiB memory. Existing Python stdlib Fraction and Node suffice.
resourcesAndPrerequisites.optionalLean: Bootstrap cap 2 agent-hours; if a pinned trusted toolchain/dependency environment is unavailable, stop that stage. If available, proof attempt cap 4 further agent-hours; record incomplete status on timeout.
resourcesAndPrerequisites.noSearch: No parameter optimization, new broad source search or recursive extra agents.

independentReview.physicsBinding: energy role or prior systems-review maintainer; must not be sole producer
independentReview.registry: corpus role consumes exact statement and receipt

stopRule: Stop after frozen cases and independent review or first unreconciled domain/semantic contradiction. Preserve failure evidence and revise contract explicitly if needed; do not expand cases to conceal failure. Optional Lean cap cannot delay acceptance of a correctly labeled rational receipt indefinitely.
limits: Finite known-model verification, not new theorem
No hardware, gap, continuum, capacity or free-energy claim
No reduction METHODS-2 work in this admission
